info.title: Stophy API
info.description: API for YouTube research workflows and agents. Search videos, get transcripts, read comments, inspect channels, fetch playlists, and return structured JSON.

tags.name: Video
tags.description: Retrieve video details, transcripts, comments, and replies.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Credit balance, request logs, and usage.

bearerAuth.description: API key from your dashboard. Prefix with Bearer in the Authorization header.

X-Concurrency-Limit.description: Max simultaneous in-flight requests for your plan.

X-Concurrency-Remaining.description: In-flight slots still available right now.

details.description: Optional additional context, present on validation errors.

VideoData.description: Shape depends on the request `type`: details, transcript, comments/replies, or livechat.

post.description: Fetch video details, transcript, comments, replies, or live chat. Pass type: details for metadata, transcript for timestamped captions, comments for top-level comments, replies for a comment thread (pass the repliesToken from a comment as continuationToken), or livechat for live stream chat messages.

type.description: The type of data to retrieve.

videoUrl.description: Full YouTube video URL. Not required when type is replies.

sortBy.description: Comment sort order. Only applies when type is comments.

chatType.description: Live chat mode. Only applies when type is livechat: 'top' = Top chat (moderated, default), 'live' = all messages. Applied on the first call; later polls keep the chosen mode.

continuationToken.description: Pagination token. Required when type is replies (use the repliesToken from a comment item); for livechat, pass the continuationToken from a previous livechat response to poll for new messages.

post.description: Search YouTube with optional filters for content type, sort order, upload date, duration, and features. Returns paginated results.

duration.description: Duration filter. Not applicable when type is short.

continuationToken.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

post.description: Retrieve channel metadata and content by channelUrl. Use the tab field to switch between videos, shorts, playlists, and about info.

channelUrl.description: Full YouTube channel URL, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd.

tab.description: Content tab to fetch. Defaults to video.

continuationToken.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

sortBy.description: Sort order for the selected tab.

post.description: Retrieve items from a YouTube playlist. Use continuationToken to page through long playlists.

continuationToken.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

get.description: Get YouTube search autocomplete suggestions for a query.

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Language code, e.g. en, fr, de. Defaults to en.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Country code, e.g. US, GB, DE. Defaults to US.

parameters.name: days

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Filter logs to a single endpoint, e.g. /video.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index. Page size is fixed at 50 entries.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Time window: 'today', the last 7 days, or the last 30 days.

parameters.name: tz
